title: The 10 Best HVLP and LVLP Spray Guns
subtitle: Gravity-feed HVLP and LVLP air spray guns for auto paint, furniture and cabinets, ranked from live Amazon data.
intro: A gravity-feed spray gun atomizes paint finely for a smooth finish on cars, cabinets and furniture. We ranked 10 best-sellers from AEROPRO, InoKraft, TCP Global, REFINE, NEIKO and value brands on rating, review volume and features (multiple nozzles, an included regulator, stated air use and two-gun sets).

changelog.note: Prices, ratings and review counts re-checked on every listing. Biggest price moves: the InoKraft D1 dropped from $119.99 to $92.99; the REFINE RF601AG/RF602AG dropped from $89.99 to $75.59; the BANG4BUCK HVLP gravity rose from $35.99 to $39.99.
Page published with 10 ranked picks and 1 tool to avoid.

avoid.name: SRQLNTT 819 HVLP Air Spray Gun Kit, 1.3/1.7/2.0 mm Nozzles, with Regulator
avoid.flag: Sold as HVLP with LVLP air specs copied from another brand
avoid.verdict: A gun sold as HVLP whose air specs say 'low air volume' and match another brand's LVLP gun word for word.
reasons: It calls itself 'HVLP (High Volume Low Pressure)', but lists 'low air volume (3.0-3.9 cfm)' at 2.0 to 3.5 bar, the exact figures AEROPRO gives for its LVLP R500.
The model number field reads 'Gravity Feed Air Paint Gun', a description rather than a model.
It's rated 4.5 stars on 104 reviews. If you want a low-air gun, the AEROPRO R500 is a real LVLP gun with a regulator and 1,176 reviews.

buyers_guide.a: HVLP guns use lots of air at low pressure for good transfer efficiency, so they need a bigger compressor. LVLP guns use less air and run on smaller compressors with similar finish quality.
1.3 to 1.5 mm for basecoat and clearcoat, 1.7 to 2.0 mm for primer and single-stage paint, 2.5 mm and up for high-build primer. Sets with several nozzles cover a whole job.
Yes. A regulator at the gun lets you set the exact pressure the gun is designed for. A water separator keeps moisture out of the paint.
Check the gun's CFM rating and buy a compressor that delivers more than that continuously. Undersized compressors cause sputtering and poor atomization.
Run the right solvent through the gun after every use and take apart the nozzle and needle. Dried paint ruins spray patterns.
